correctness.rationale: Balance in the finite stationary recurrent sandpile implies expected total topplings = 1^T L^{-1}e_r. The exact rooted-tree Green kernel and Sherman--Morrison give 1+(sum subtree sizes -1)/(d+2) for a chord from source to depth d; a root-to-chord path loses at least i-1 other vertices from its ith descendant set, yielding the universal sharp upper bound and attainment on a path. The integer maximizer and asymptotic follow by consecutive differences. Complementary exact rational tests check 20,796 all-edge augmentations and 7,035 rooted-source chord instances for N<=5.

value.rationale: A sharp, structurally motivated perturbation extremum for a natural stationary finite sandpile observable: from mean one to a linear-in-N optimal mean using one edge, with exact graph topology and optimized chord distance. Quantifies how a local connectivity modification can amplify global avalanche activity, with maximum degree at most three.
